Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty is released.

14.t: The New Musical Express publishes the first regular UK Singles Chart.
Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald is released.
The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie is released.
Need for Speed: ProStreet is released.

15.t: Halo: Combat Evolved is released in North America for the original Xbox.
Intel announces the 4004, the first commercial microprocessor.
Need for Speed: The Run is released.
Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order is released.
Need for Speed Rivals is released.

16.t: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone opens in the UK and US.
The Temptations release their Greatest Hits album, which goes on to be the Billboard Year-End R&B album of 1967.
The Jussi Awards, the Finnish film award ceremony, is held for the first time at Restaurant Adlon in Helsinki.
Pop group Milli Vanilli are stripped of their Grammy Award because the duo did not sing at all on the Girl You Know It's True album.
Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them is released.
The Twilight Saga: New Moon is released.
Need for Speed: Hot Pursuit is released.

17.t: Luna programme: The Soviet Union lands Lunokhod 1 on Mare Imbrium (Sea of Rains) on the Moon.
Need for Speed: Underground is released.
Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater is released.

18.t: Minecraft 1.0, the game's full release, is launched.
Walt Disney's Steamboat Willie premieres in New York, the first fully synchronized sound cartoon.
The first comic of Calvin and Hobbes is published in ten newspapers.
The Bell Telephone Company introduces the first push-button telephone.
Star Trek: First Contact is released.
The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword is released.
Need for Speed: Undercover is released.

19.t: Nintendo's Wii launches in North America.
John Carpenter becomes the first person to win the top prize in the TV game show Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?

21.t: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is released in Japan.
The Super Famicom, known as the Super NES elsewhere, launches in Japan.
The first permanent ARPANET link is established between UCLA and SRI.
The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past is released.
Super Smash Bros. Melee is released.

22.t: Toy Story, the first fully computer-animated feature film, is released.
Command & Conquer: Red Alert is released.

23.t: Doctor Who airs its first episode on the BBC.
World of Warcraft launches in North America.
The first smartphone, the IBM Simon, is introduced at COMDEX in Las Vegas, Nevada.

26.t: Casablanca, the movie starring Humphrey Bogart and Ingrid Bergman, premieres in New York City.
The Toll of the Sea debuts as the first general release film to use two-tone Technicolor.
Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home is released.

29.t: Atari's Pong arcade game is released in North America.
Atari releases Pong, the first commercially successful video game.
"I Want to Hold Your Hand", recorded on October 17, 1963, is released by the Beatles in the United Kingdom.

30.t: Prince of Persia: Warrior Within is released.

1.t: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege is released.
Prince of Persia: The Two Thrones is released.

2.t: Guardian: The Lonely and Great God premieres.
A Few Good Men is released.

3.t: Sony's original PlayStation launches in Japan.
The first SMS text message is sent. It reads 'Merry Christmas.'
A test engineer for Sema Group uses a personal computer to send the world's first text message via the Vodafone network to the phone of a colleague.
In Cincinnati, 11 fans are suffocated in a crush for seats on the concourse outside Riverfront Coliseum before a Who concert.
The musical Camelot debuts at the Majestic Theatre on Broadway. It will become associated with the Kennedy administration.
Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street is released.

4.t: Jumanji: The Next Level is released.

6.t: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country is released.

7.t: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate is released.

8.t: Metallica performs a show in Antarctica, making them the first musical act to perform on all seven continents.
The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe is released.

9.t: Douglas Engelbart demos the mouse, hypertext and video conferencing in 'The Mother of All Demos.'
The Chronicles of Narnia: The Voyage of the Dawn Treader is released.
Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness is released.

12.t: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo is released.

14.t: The Walt Disney Company announces that it would acquire 21st Century Fox, including the 20th Century Fox movie studio, for $52.4 billion.
Mission: Impossible – Ghost Protocol is released.

15.t: Gone with the Wind (highest inflation adjusted grossing film) receives its premiere at Loew's Grand Theatre in Atlanta, Georgia, United States.
The Pursuit of Happyness is released.

16.t: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows is released.
Alvin and the Chipmunks: Chipwrecked is released.
Lemony Snicket's A Series of Unfortunate Events is released.

17.t: What's Eating Gilbert Grape is released.
Anna and the King is released.

18.t: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip is released.
My Love from the Star premieres.

19.t: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring opens in the US.

20.t: The world's first website, info.cern.ch, is published.
Captain America Comics #1, containing the first appearance of the superhero Captain America, is published.
Alvin and the Chipmunks is released.
Star Wars: The Old Republic is released.

21.t: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs, the world's first full-length animated feature, premieres at the Carthay Circle Theatre.

23.t: The transistor is first demonstrated at Bell Laboratories.
As Good as It Gets is released.

25.t: The Theory of Everything is released.
Extremely Loud and Incredibly Close is released.

26.t: The Beatles' "I Want to Hold Your Hand" and "I Saw Her Standing There" are released in the United States, marking the beginning of Beatlemania on an international level.

27.t: Kern and Hammerstein's musical play Show Boat, considered to be the first true American musical play, opens at the Ziegfeld Theatre on Broadway.

29.t: Cecil B. DeMille starts filming Hollywood's first feature film, The Squaw Man.

30.t: Shaun of the Dead is released.

31.t: The final comic of Calvin and Hobbes is published.
